description: All 15 alternations from the official AGENT_PATTERN regex, converted to individual content filter entries compatible with the fork gacor contentFilters.js system. The official code replaces the ENTIRE system prompt with a neutral one when text.length > 2000 OR any pattern matches. The fork gacor content filter system replaces only matched fragments per-pattern, not the whole message.
neutralPrompt: You are a helpful AI assistant that helps with software engineering tasks.
catchAllNote: Official also catches system prompts > 2000 chars regardless of content — this is a length check, not a regex, and cannot be expressed as a content filter pattern. Would need a separate code-level guard in the executor.
caseSensitivityNote: Official AGENT_PATTERN uses /i flag (case-insensitive). Fork gacor contentFilters.js compiles with new RegExp(pattern, 'g') — case-SENSITIVE only. Patterns below are written in lowercase as they appear in the original regex. To match case-insensitively, either add 'i' flag to the regex constructor in contentFilters.js, or rewrite each pattern with character classes like [Yy]ou are [Cc]laude [Cc]ode.
behavioralDifference: Official: if ANY pattern matches OR length > 2000 → replace ENTIRE system prompt with neutralPrompt. Fork gacor filter: each pattern independently replaces only the matched text fragment with the replacement string. 'remove' literally inserts the word 'remove' as replacement text.
